title: A door needs a quarter-circle
hook: Where can this light basket clear the door?

claims.text: The door sweeps a quarter-circle whose radius is the door's width. In the model, anything closer to the hinge than 85 cm is inside that arc. Real handles and basket shapes need extra room, and exits must stay clear.
